entities.name: Control plane service type
entities.description: Specifies the purpose of the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message. It is a type 1 information element with values indicating mobile originating request, mobile terminating request, or unused values interpreted as mobile originating request.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Message whose purpose is specified by the Control plane service type information element.

entities.name: Control plane service type IEI
entities.description: Information Element Identifier for Control plane service type, located in bits 5-8 of octet 1.

entities.name: Active flag
entities.description: Active flag indicator located in bit 4 of octet 1.

entities.name: Control plane service type value
entities.description: Control plane service type value located in bits 1-3 of octet 1, with values: 000=mobile originating request, 001=mobile terminating request, 010=unused (interpreted as mobile originating request).

entities.name: Mobile originating request
entities.description: Condition when Control plane service type value bits are 000 or unused value 010 is received.

entities.name: Mobile terminating request
entities.description: Condition when Control plane service type value bits are 001.

relations.description: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message contains the Control plane service type information element to specify its purpose.
Control plane service type IE contains the IEI field.
Control plane service type IE contains the Active flag field.
Control plane service type IE contains the Control plane service type value field.
Control plane service type value field is guarded by mobile originating request condition when bits are 000 or unused value 010 is received.
Control plane service type value field is guarded by mobile terminating request condition when bits are 001.
